title: "Explore a research question through linked evidence"
subtitle: "DuckDB relational prototype · bounded Bertom example"
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
    mathjax: null
    toc: true
    toc_depth: 2
params:
  report: null
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE, error=FALSE)
r <- params$report
```

This is a **local, curated prototype** read from a DuckDB database at render time. It does not query EMMA or search the complete institutional record. Relationships, source coverage and assessments retain the status shown below; no project-success conclusion is implied. The saved HTML is a snapshot, not a live database view.

## Starting question

```{r question, results='asis'}
cat(knitr::kable(r$question, format='html', escape=TRUE))
```

## Related hypotheses

The hypothesis and its relationship to the question may be proposed interpretations, not adopted project statements.

```{r hypotheses, results='asis'}
if (nrow(r$hypotheses)) cat(knitr::kable(r$hypotheses, format='html', escape=TRUE)) else cat('<p>No hypothesis link is recorded in this prototype.</p>')
```

## Studies and reported findings

The relationship's direction, status and scope explain why a study appears. Source hashes identify the cited file version; they do not establish that the relationship is scientifically validated. A survey or report finding can exist without a recorded EMMA monitoring task or recovered raw observations.

```{r findings, results='asis'}
if (nrow(r$findings)) cat(knitr::kable(r$findings, format='html', escape=TRUE)) else cat('<p>No linked findings are recorded in this prototype. This is not proof that none exist.</p>')
```

## Assessments

```{r assessments, results='asis'}
if (r$include_hypothetical) cat('<p><strong>Illustrative records are enabled.</strong> Hypothetical entries are not practitioner-authored assessments or decisions.</p>')
if (nrow(r$assessments)) cat(knitr::kable(r$assessments, format='html', escape=TRUE)) else cat('<p>No assessment is shown. Hypothetical examples are excluded by default; absence here does not prove none exist elsewhere.</p>')
```

## Scope and provenance

Source-document identity, passage locators and hashes above come from the database. The local fixture uses prior source reviews, not an automated extraction run or a live systems connection. [Bertom source and linkage review](https://github.com/MVR-GIS/restorationmonitoring/blob/main/dev/goals/bertom-rock-habitat-linkage-review.md) and the [DuckDB prototype and migration crosswalk](https://github.com/MVR-GIS/restorationmonitoring/blob/main/dev/architecture/duckdb-mvp-and-emma-migration.md) explain the scope and known gaps.

```{r provenance, results='asis'}
cat(knitr::kable(data.frame(Item=c('Generated (UTC)', 'Database MD5 at read', 'DuckDB R package'),
  Value=c(r$generated_at, r$database_md5, r$duckdb_version)), format='html', escape=TRUE))
```
